paper.title_en: Astrometric effects of anisotropic gravitational wave backgrounds
paper.abstract_en: Precise astrometric observations of distant objects such as stars and quasars can be used to probe gravitational wave signals at nanohertz frequencies. A stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) produces correlated apparent motions of pairs of objects on the sky. That correlation as a function of their angular separation is the astrometric analog of the Hellings-Downs curve in the context of pulsar timing measurements. Upper limits on the SGWB have been obtained from very-long baseline interferometry and Gaia astrometry, and future Gaia data releases are expected to improve them. An astrophysical background from inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries is expected to be significantly anisotropic. In this work, we compute the astrometric correlation functions for an anisotropic SGWB, known as the generalized overlap reduction functions, for all six gravitational wave polarizations. We present closed-form expressions in all cases where the distant-light source limit can be applied, following the approach used for pulsar timing arrays. We find that the correlations differ qualitatively between the tensor, vector, and scalar polarizations. Finally, we discuss the applicability of these results in future astrometry searches for arbitrarily polarized anisotropic gravitational wave backgrounds.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将脉冲星计时阵列中的Hellings-Downs型关联函数推广到天体测量情形，给出全部六种引力波偏振下各向异性随机引力波背景的广义重叠约化函数的闭式表达；对纳赫兹引力波探测有直接方法学价值，理论与表述清晰，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 各向异性引力波背景的天体测量效应
decision.abstract_zh: 对恒星和类星体等遥远天体的精确天体测量观测，可用于探测纳赫兹频率的引力波信号。随机引力波背景（SGWB）会在天球上产生成对目标之间的相关视运动。该相关性作为角间距的函数，是脉冲星计时测量中Hellings-Downs曲线在天体测量情形下的类比。SGWB的上限已由甚长基线干涉测量和Gaia天体测量获得，未来Gaia数据释放预计将改进这些上限。来自旋近超大质量黑洞双星的河内天体物理背景预计显著各向异性。本工作中，我们计算了各向异性SGWB的天体测量关联函数，即广义重叠约化函数，涵盖全部六种引力波偏振。在可应用远光源极限的所有情形下，我们仿照脉冲星计时阵列所用的方法给出闭式表达式。我们发现，张量、矢量与标量偏振之间的相关性存在定性差异。最后，我们讨论了这些结果在未来天体测量搜寻任意偏振各向异性引力波背景中的适用性。
